en: A woven arm-band in Oruvel's oil-black and brass. Tavi kept it on his own wrist for the boy who took the Gull home to look.
The float Oruvel's side brought up to win the Tidecup's opening round: cork bound in brass, its paint gone soft with handling. A side keeps the float it wins with.
A room on stilts over the river mouth, hammocks strung two to a wall, and the market's voices coming up through the boards until late.
